subject: phy
title: Electricity
subtitle: Electricity with model-based reasoning, equations, and exam application.
concept: Electric circuits model energy transfer using charge flow and potential difference. Current describes charge rate, while potential difference describes energy transferred per unit charge.
Resistance links current and potential difference through material and geometric factors. Ohm law behavior applies to ohmic conductors under constant temperature conditions.
Circuit analysis combines conservation of charge and energy. Correct series-parallel reasoning is essential in AS calculations.
